snippet: The Iranian central bank has drafted a new report outlining cryptocurrency regulations in the country.

title: Stablecoin Issuers May Need Licenses in Texas, Unlike Most Crypto Startups
snippet: A new memo by the Texas Department of Banking notes that stablecoins may fall under the state's definition of "money" and therefore would be subject to money transmission laws.

title: Switzerland to Regulate Blockchain Within Existing Financial Laws
snippet: Switzerland's government plans to accommodate the blockchain sector within existing financial laws, but with a few tweaks.

title: The CFTC Wants to Learn More About Ethereum
snippet: The CFTC has published a request for input to learn more about ethereum and its underlying blockchain network.

title: Treasury Official: Global Regulators Must Follow US Lead in Crypto Enforcement
snippet: U.S. Treasury Department Under Secretary Sigal Mandelker called for global efforts to police malicious actors' use of cryptocurrencies.

title: G20 Leaders Pledge Crypto-Asset Regulation After Buenos Aires Meeting
snippet: G20 leaders declared that they would regulate crypto to mitigate financial crimes in a statement after this weekend's summit.

title: Taiwanese Lawmaker Proposes New Business Category for Crypto Startups
snippet: Taiwanese legislator Jason Hsu wants the island to create a new business category for cryptocurrency activities, he said Friday.

title: The SEC Is Setting Up a New Division to Talk to ICO Startups
snippet: The SEC's new FinHub is being launched with the aim of facilitating interactions with fintech startups, including ICO issuers.
